description: This file contains utility functions for iterating over Protocol Buffer descriptors, filtering by syntax version, message types, fields, and enums within protobuf descriptor files.

methods.name: ForEachFile
methods.description: Iterates over a list of FileDescriptorProto objects, applying a provided function to each.

methods.name: OnlyProto2
methods.description: Filters and returns files with syntax not equal to 'proto3'.

methods.name: OnlyProto3
methods.description: Filters and returns files with syntax equal to 'proto3'.

methods.name: ForEachMessageInFiles
methods.description: Iterates over all messages in a list of files, applying a function to each message.

methods.name: ForEachMessage
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to each message and nested message.

methods.name: ForEachFieldInFilesExcludingExtensions
methods.description: Iterates over fields in files, excluding extension fields.

methods.name: ForEachFieldInFiles
methods.description: Iterates over all fields and extensions in files.

methods.name: ForEachFieldExcludingExtensions
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to fields in messages, excluding extension fields.

methods.name: ForEachField
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to fields and extensions in messages.

methods.name: ForEachEnumInFiles
methods.description: Iterates over all enums in files, applying a function to each.

methods.name: ForEachEnum
methods.description: Recursively applies a function to enums in messages.
